rationale: EO 10771 (June 20, 1958) amended EO 10534 on supervision and direction of the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation. EO 11382 of November 28, 1967, Sec. 16 (Revocations) revokes Executive Order No. 10771 of June 20, 1958 (and EO 10534, 10858 and 10968) by name, without an "in part" qualifier. The status is NO as of 2026-10-14. The first end of Sec. 1 (Defense supervision that terminates upon completion of the construction) is left unresolved in the lifecycle sheet, but the revocation of the whole order is dated and held.
